simple64.note: PAL opens pif.pal.rom, NTSC and MPAL pif.ntsc.rom. Both are optional, HLE runs without them.

n64-country.description: Byte 0x3E of the header after the byte order is normalised (0x00 reads 80 37 12 40 in .z64, 37 80 40 12 in .v64, 40 12 37 80 in .n64). The core knows only PAL and NTSC.
